name: Sparse Volume Texture Setup
aliases: Heterogeneous Volumes (HV) with Sparse Volume Textures (SVT)
Sparse Volume Texture Setup — Heterogeneous Volume (Modified Unreal Engine)
definition: A volume rendering approach in Unreal Engine 5 that uses Sparse Volume Textures (SVT) to render large datasets (up to ~6 gigavoxels) by storing data in sparse tiles within a large volume texture, allowing circumvention of the DirectX 12 API limit of 2048 voxels per dimension.
summary: Sparse Volume Texture Setup renders massive datasets in Unreal Engine 5 by storing data in sparse tiles within a single large volume texture, circumventing DirectX 12 API limits.
